description: Run an analysis case — once, over the rows of a sweep (`ranges`), or as a Monte Carlo sample (`runs`) — and record the runs into the model as AnalysisRecords declarations (the RecordRun RPC, the CLI's -record-run/-record-into, the REPL's %record). `run`, `sweep` or `sample` is the runs' own report; `package`, `definition` and `records` name what the model gained and `source` is the declarations generated; `documents` (and `content` for a single document) is the notation of the document the records merged into, or the records as a document of their own, and `modelHash` names the recorded model, cached for the next request. A recording that would error or drop a declaration leaves the model unchanged and is the `error`. The result is the RecordRunResponse as protojson writes it.

acceptDocuments.description: read the recorded notation from documents rather than content; required for a model of several documents

analysisSymbolId.description: qualified name of the analysis case definition or usage to run and record

arguments.description: positional values for the case's in parameters, each a protojson Value

engine.description: the analysis engine asked, as list_engines names them; empty is auto

modelHash.description: the model_hash a parse answered; give this, or paths and/or sources to parse first

namedArguments.description: values for the case's in parameters by name, each a protojson Value

paths.description: model files to parse as one model, absolute or relative to the workspace root

ranges.description: ranges of the case's parameters to run it over as run_sweep does, recording each completed row; each a protojson SweepRange

recordInto.description: package the records go into (-record-into); empty is a Records package beside the package enclosing the case's own

runs.description: run the Simulation::MonteCarlo case this many times as run_runs does and record each completed run and the sample's conclusion (-runs)

seed.description: seed of the sample's draws; required with runs

sources.description: documents given inline, parsed with paths as one model

language.description: sysml or kerml; empty is inferred from path's extension, sysml when it has none

path.description: name the document is reported by in diagnostics and indexed under; a .kerml extension makes it KerML unless language says otherwise

text.description: the document's source text; empty is an empty document

strictConformance.description: judge the documents as conforming SysML v2: notation no pinned production admits is an error rather than a warning

subjectSymbolId.description: qualified name of a part/usage to instantiate as the subject, or a path from one to a nested object

name: record_run
